messages:
Maria (CEO): Thanks everyone who asked questions in the Q&A. Dropping a follow-up thread so we can capture quicker clarifications about headcount and team changes. Keep it short; we'll escalate complex ones to 1:1s.

Zoe (PM): Can you confirm whether product-area boundaries are changing or just reporting lines? I want to know if ROADMAP owners move too.

Devon (Head of Product): Primary change = clearer ownership boundaries. Most roadmap ownership stays with product area owners, but a few cross-cutting infra responsibilities will get new stewards. We'll publish a diff of ROADMAP owners (old->new) by Tue COB.

Malik (SWE): If my team gets a new steward, do SLAs or OKRs change mid-quarter?

Chris (VP Eng): No retroactive OKR rewrites. For the transition window (2-6 weeks) we'll add outcome owners but keep commitments the same. Any scope changes must be approved by product + Eng leads.

Anita (People Ops): Quick hiring note: We're operating under a constrained Q2 headcount envelope. Hiring is prioritized toward reliability, infra, and CS. Internal transfers are encouraged and evaluated separately from external reqs.

Malik (SWE): Does "prioritized" mean some posted reqs will be paused?

Sanjay (Finance): Correct. Posted reqs can be paused if they fall outside priority buckets. Hiring managers should fill the intake form with business case + expected start quarter to help decisions.

Zoe (PM): For teams that expect growth beyond Q2 (planned features), how do we signal deferred hiring so we don't lose candidates?

Anita (People Ops): Use the hiring intake -> select "deferred - candidate nurturing". Recruiter team will maintain a pipeline and keep candidates warm. DM Recruiter Bot if you have high-priority candidates.

Recruiter Bot: Automated: hiring intake -> https://internal.redwood/hire-intake. For candidate nurture: tag "nurture-q2".

Devon (Head of Product): Manager hires: we're allocating a small number of manager hires based on clear team size or critical leadership gaps. We're not doing broad manager hiring right now.

Malik (SWE): How will manager capacity be judged? number-of-reports or complexity?

Chris (VP Eng): Both. Heavier weight to complexity and cross-team dependencies. As a rule of thumb: teams with >9 direct ICs or >2 cross-service ownership items are prioritized.

Zoe (PM): Will there be a bump in IC->manager promotion slots to offset fewer external manager hires?

Anita (People Ops): We'll accelerate some internal manager calibrations where there's a clear candidate match. Promotions follow the existing leveling matrix; we'll publish a FAQ about internal promotion timelines in 3 business days.

Malik (SWE): Org chart ETA? Our sprint planning needs new owner names.

Devon (Head of Product): Draft org chart tomorrow morning; final by next Wed EOD. We'll drop a CSV mapping (owner, team, new_team) in the handbook.

Zoe (PM): Any changes to on-call responsibilities with ownership shifts?

Chris (VP Eng): No immediate on-call reshuffle. We may create temporary rotation overlaps for 2-3 weeks if ownership crosses teams. Ops playbook will have explicit steps.

Anita (People Ops): Office hours for sensitive Qs: Thu 10:00, Thu 14:00, Fri 11:30 PT. Book via: https://cal.internal/people-ops. Private transfers should go through your manager + People Ops.

Malik (SWE): What's the expected notice period for internal moves? Want to be respectful of handoffs.

Anita (People Ops): Target: 2 weeks notice, plus a 1-sprint overlap where possible. If critical, we'll coordinate an extended handover plan.

Sanjay (Finance): Process note: approved reqs need cost-center and justification in intake for budget tagging. This avoids delays.

Devon (Head of Product): Action items recap:
1) Org diff CSV (old->new owners) by Tue COB.
2) Org chart final Wed EOD.
3) Hiring rubric + intake link pinned here.
4) People Ops office hours + Calendly link.

Recruiter Bot: Doc posted: https://internal.redwood/all-hands/1730501234-followup (contains org-diff.csv, hire-intake, FAQ). :white_check_mark:

Maria (CEO): Appreciate the questions. Reorg goal is clarity and velocity, not headcount cuts. If you're anxious, talk to your manager or People Ops. We're prioritizing minimal disruption. :heart:
